definitions.explanation: Indicates that something will happen after a period of time, but not immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やがて⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、やがて⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}くようになった→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The long winter ended, and before long warm days became the norm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧したが、やがて⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧まで⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He struggled when he was young, but eventually he came to own his own company.

notes:
やがて suggests that something will happen naturally after a period of time. It implies inevitability and gradual progression rather than sudden change.

USAGE:
Typically used in written or slightly formal contexts. Often appears in narratives to describe the natural passage of time or the inevitable outcome of a process.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やがて: before long, eventually (gradual, natural progression)
- ⟦{遂|つい}に→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧: finally, at last (after a long wait)
- そのうち: before long, sometime soon (casual)
